动态处理、Limiter、等响试听与侧链使用指南: Dynamics, Limiter, level-matched listening and sidechain guide
检测电平由低到高（作用区间示意）: Detector level: low to high (active intervals)
静态曲线示意：Threshold=-24 dB、Ratio=4:1、Range=: Static curves: Threshold=-24 dB, Ratio=4:1, Range=OFF; no compensation, boundary transitions or detector timing.
控制动态，尽量保留原本的起音。: Control dynamics. Keep the attack natural.
先决定需要多稳的动态、要保留多少起音，再调整参数。图表帮助理解变化，但不代替听音: Decide how steady the dynamics should be and how much articulation to retain. The Display helps explain changes; it does not replace listening.
Classic / Super、单压与上压: Classic / Super, Single and upward processing
双压、独立开关与 Ratio LINK: Dual, branch switches and Ratio LINK
Input / Output LINK、Match 与 A/B: Input / Output LINK, Match and A/B
ST / LR / MS 与声道 LINK: ST / LR / MS and channel LINK
主要音频控件保持在同一位置，换主题不改变功能。: The same audio controls remain in place across all themes.
Light / ST。图中数值用于说明界面，不是固定推荐预设。: Light / ST. The values illustrate the interface; they are not a recommended preset.
查看当前设置下的历史电平与增益参考，见第 15 页。: View historical level and gain references under current settings; see page 15.
单压为 Threshold / Range；双压为 UP / DOWN 阈值。: Threshold / Range in Single; UP / DOWN thresholds in Dual.
检查输入、输出电平与有效动态增益。: Check input, output and effective dynamic gain.
调整音量、Ratio 和 Mix；在 Ratio 旁切换单压 / 双压。: Adjust gain, Ratio and Mix; switch Single / Dual beside Ratio.
选择通道方式，联动参数或单独监听。: Choose channel processing, link controls or audition domains.
界面采用 3:2 横向比例。拖动右下角可以调整大小，下次打开时会记住上一次的界面: The interface uses a 3:2 landscape aspect ratio. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize it. The plugin remembers the last size when reopened.
点击界面右上角显示 LIGHT、DARK 或 CLASSIC 的主题按钮，即可循: Click the top-right button labelled LIGHT, DARK or CLASSIC to cycle themes. The last selection is restored when the plug-in opens again.
主题按钮位于 SC 按钮右侧、A/B 按钮左侧。: The theme button is between SC and A/B.
三种主题只改变外观。CLASSIC 主题与 ALGO: CLASSIC 是两个独: Themes change appearance only. The CLASSIC theme is separate from ALGO: CLASSIC: one changes the visual style, the other changes the processing algorithm.
恢复默认值；联动开启时，相关控件也会跟随并受范围限制。: Restore the default. When linked, related controls follow within their allowed ranges.
Classic 与 Super：两种动态曲线: Classic and Super: two dynamic curves
阈值以上按固定 dB 比例压缩。下压时，超出阈值的 dB 数除以 Ratio，决: A fixed dB ratio above the threshold. For downward compression, divide the excess dB by Ratio to find how much excess remains.
使用原有 QQ 曲线。Ratio 决定曲线力度，但不表示每一个电平位置都具有固定: The original QQ curve. Ratio sets its strength, but does not describe a fixed dB compression ratio at every detector level.
Classic 下压：Threshold=-10 dB、Ratio=5:1、Ra: Classic downward: Threshold=-10 dB, Ratio=5:1, Range=OFF. A steady detector level of 0 dB exceeds the threshold by 10 dB. Compression leaves 2 dB of that excess, giving -8 dB. At -12 dB, the detector stays below threshold and receives no dynamic attenuation.
示例采用内部检测，Input、Makeup、Output Gain 均为 0 d: This example uses internal detection, 0 dB Input, Makeup and Output Gain, and Mix=100%. The formula describes a steady detector level, not a hard limit on individual samples. For changing signals and the Display, see pages 15-16.
向上分支仍然提升门槛以上的部分: Upward processing still boosts above the lower gate
两种算法的 Up 都以低阈值作为允许提升的门槛。Classic 使用与倒数 Do: In both algorithms, the lower threshold enables boost above it. Classic uses the dB slope corresponding to the reciprocal Down Ratio; Super uses the original upward curve. Both share the same active intervals, Range behavior and Dual handoff rules.
它们都能影响结果，但不能互相精确替代。: Three useful controls, not interchangeable settings.
普通压缩的单压以 1:1 为中点：高于 1:1 时向下压缩，低于 1:1 时向上: Normal Single processing is neutral at 1:1: above it, processing is downward; below it, processing is upward. Within the active threshold range, higher downward ratios usually cut more, while smaller upward ratios usually boost more. Dual separates UP RATIO and DOWN RATIO; see page 9.
Input Gain 调整进入处理路径的电平，也会改变 Dry 路径的音量。使用: Input Gain changes the level entering the processing path, including the Dry path. With INT it also changes the detector level relative to Threshold. With EXT, the external send and Key Gain set the detector level; Input Gain is not a substitute.
Mix 在 Dry 和处理后的 Wet 之间混合。它不只是一个附加效果比例，也是: Mix blends Dry with processed Wet. It is also a useful processing amount control: first make the boost or cut clear, then lower Mix to blend back the original dynamics you want to retain.
Mix = 0% 时有效动态增益为 0 dB；100% 时保留完整处理量。中间值: At Mix = 0%, effective dynamic gain is 0 dB; at 100%, the full processing amount is retained. Intermediate values are not simply the gain in dB multiplied by Mix. Makeup and Output Gain are excluded from this dynamic gain.
实用顺序：先调 Ratio 找到处理感，再用 Mix 控制最终力度；需要改变整体: A practical order: find the compression character with Ratio, set its final strength with Mix, adjust Input Gain when you need a different input level, then compare loudness again.
先决定哪些电平参与处理，再用 Ratio 选择方向与力度。: Choose the active levels, then set direction and strength with Ratio.
SINGLE：下方 Threshold 与上方 Range 共同限定范围，推子与: SINGLE: the lower Threshold and upper Range define the processing interval. The faders align with the dashed lines in the display.
按 Ratio 向上或向下处理。: Upward or downward processing, according to Ratio.
达到或超过有限 Range: At or above a finite Range
完全恢复为 0 dB 动态增益。: Returns fully to 0 dB dynamic gain.
Range 位于顶端 OFF 时不设置上界，按所选算法继续处理。将它从上往下拉，: At its top OFF position, Range imposes no upper limit on the selected algorithm. Pull it down to set a cutoff. A finite 0 dB setting differs from OFF. Classic Threshold stops at -90 dB; Super retains -inf, meaning no lower gate.
接近有限 Range 时，动态增益会在范围内连续回到 0 dB，避免跨越上界时突: Near a finite Range, dynamic gain returns continuously to 0 dB from inside the active interval, avoiding a sudden jump across the boundary. This transition follows detector level; it adds no Attack time or extra latency.
Range 始终在 Threshold 上方或与其重合。拖动一根撞到另一根时，另: Range stays at or above Threshold. When one fader reaches the other, it moves the other along; coincident boundaries disable dynamic processing. Drag back to separate them.
这里的“0 dB 动态增益”只指动态分支不提升、不衰减；Input、Makeup: Here, 0 dB dynamic gain means the dynamic branch applies no boost or cut. Input, Makeup, Mix and Output Gain still work, and Limiter's final Ceiling remains independent. With EXT, the external detector signal determines the active range.
Classic 与 Super 都使用这项门槛规则，让选中的细节更靠前。: Classic and Super both use this gate rule to bring selected detail forward.
在 SINGLE 中，将 Ratio 从 1:1 向左调，例如 1:2、1:4、: In SINGLE, move Ratio below 1:1, for example to 1:2, 1:4 or 1:8, to enter upward processing. The displayed 1:8 means 1/8. Smaller values generally give eligible material more boost.
门槛决定是否提升，不把声音关掉: The gate enables boost; it does not mute audio
Threshold 在这里像一个允许提升的门槛。门槛以下仍保留原音量，并不是把更: Threshold acts as a gate that allows boost above it. Below the gate, the original level is retained: quieter sounds are neither muted nor specifically boosted.
先圈出想抬起来的内容: Select the detail to bring forward
切到 SINGLE，以 Threshold 设下限、Range 设上限。例如先用: Select SINGLE. Set a lower Threshold and upper Range, for example -50 dB / -10 dB. Listen for the detail you want between them. These values are examples only.
从 1:1 逐渐向 1:2、1:4 调整；觉得提升过多时，减小力度或降低 Mix: Move gradually from 1:1 toward 1:2 and 1:4. If the boost is too strong, reduce its strength or lower Mix. Do not substitute Makeup for dynamic boost.
同时听安静处和较响处: Listen to quiet and loud passages
越接近下限门槛，提升会平滑进入；离开这段过渡后，作用范围内较轻的部分通常获得更多: Boost enters smoothly near the lower gate. Beyond that transition, quieter parts in the active interval generally receive more boost. Boost approaches 0 dB near the upper boundary. Range OFF removes the finite upper cutoff.
想保留很轻的呼吸、底噪或残响原有音量时，将下限门槛放在它们上方，再听需要的主体是: To leave very quiet breaths, noise or reverb at their original level, place the lower gate above them. Check that the desired material still enters the boost interval. Selection follows detector level, not sound type.
双压：较轻处提升，较响处压低: Dual: lift quieter parts, control louder ones
点击 Ratio 旁的小按钮，将 SINGLE 切换为 DUAL。: Click the small button beside Ratio to change SINGLE to DUAL.
DUAL：UP RATIO 与 DOWN RATIO 分别控制两种方向；UP /: DUAL: UP RATIO and DOWN RATIO control the two directions separately. UP / DOWN thresholds replace Threshold / Range.
达到 DOWN 阈值时，动态增益回到 0 dB；超过后停止上压，只由 Down: At DOWN, dynamic gain returns to 0 dB. Above it, upward processing stops and only Down Ratio applies. The two gains never stack at the same detector level. Dual has no Range control.
低阈值与高阈值从两端开始；不是关闭上压。: The thresholds start at opposite ends; this does not disable upward processing.
两种动态处理都处于中性状态，需调整 Ratio 才能听到效果。: Both directions are neutral. Adjust a Ratio to hear processing.
DOWN 必须在 UP 上方或与其重合。拖动相撞会推着另一根一起移动；两阈值重合: DOWN must stay at or above UP. When one fader reaches the other, it pushes the other along. Dynamic processing stops when the thresholds coincide.
UP 与 DOWN 之间提升，超过 DOWN 后压低。: Boost between UP and DOWN; attenuation above DOWN.
只保留上压；达到 DOWN 后仍停止提升。: Upward only. Boost still stops at DOWN.
只保留下压；低于 DOWN 时不作动态处理。: Downward only. No dynamic processing below DOWN.
不作动态提升或衰减；其余音量与 Mix 设置仍有效。: No dynamic boost or attenuation. Other gain and Mix settings still apply.
先建立完整的 Dual 设置: Set up the full Dual sound
设好两个阈值和 Ratio，播放包含轻声与较响片段的素材。: Set both thresholds and Ratios. Play material with quiet and loud passages.
看显示，再做等响度比较: Check the display and compare at similar loudness
开关会改变对应的动态增益与 Display 历史参考。最后补偿整体音量，比较细节: The switches update dynamic gain and the Display history reference. Compensate overall level, then compare detail, articulation and consistency.
每一路 ON / OFF 使用短交叉淡变，减少切换瞬态。关闭某一路不会移动阈值，: Each branch uses a short crossfade to reduce ON / OFF transients. Switching a branch off neither moves the thresholds nor extends the other branch into a different interval. In LR / MS, each channel has its own switches.
两个 Ratio 之间偏上的小 LINK，只在 DUAL 中显示。: The small LINK above and between the two Ratios appears only in DUAL.
Up 与 Down 各自保留原来的相对关系；打开 LINK 不会使数值跳变。: Up and Down retain their existing relative relationship. Enabling LINK does not make values jump.
首次使用时 Ratio LINK 默认开启。之后会记住你上次的选择；重新打开已保: Ratio LINK defaults to on at first use, then remembers your last choice. When reopening a saved project, the LINK state saved in that project takes priority.
例如 Down 加倍，Up 的数值就减半；调 Up 时也是同样的反向关系。从 4: For example, doubling Down halves the Up value; adjusting Up uses the same inverse relationship. Starting at 4:1 and 1:2 will not force them into a reciprocal pair. Dragging, fine adjustment and direct entry all follow this rule.
到达边界，会一起停下: At a limit, both stop together
可直接关闭 DOWN 旁的开关，保留 Down Ratio 数值。若还要单独调整: Switch DOWN off to preserve its Ratio while auditioning Up. To adjust Up Ratio independently as well, turn off the small Ratio LINK; otherwise the Down value still follows your adjustment.
小 LINK 会随紧凑布局缩小，仍位于 Up / Down Ratio 之间。它: The small LINK scales down with compact layouts and stays between Up / Down Ratio. It links those Ratios within each channel. Channel LINK beside Mode links L/R or M/S; see page 20.
Input / Output LINK：反向补偿增益: Input / Output LINK: opposite gain changes
位于 INPUT GAIN 右上方，与 Ratio LINK 分开工作。: Above and to the right of INPUT GAIN. It is separate from Ratio LINK.
示例：Input 为 +3 dB，Output 为 -3 dB，LINK 开启。: Example: Input +3 dB, Output -3 dB, with LINK enabled.
打开 LINK 后，在界面上增加 Input Gain，Output Gain: With LINK on, raising Input Gain in the interface lowers Output Gain by the same number of dB. Adjusting Output moves Input in the opposite direction too. This helps reduce simple level changes while you explore a different level entering the processor.
它按变化量反向联动，不会强行把两个数值变成互为相反数。只开启或关闭 LINK，当: The link follows relative changes; it does not force the two values to be exact opposites. Toggling LINK alone leaves the gains unchanged. If either control reaches its allowed limit, both stop together.
Match 与 Makeup：补偿后再判断动态: Match and Makeup: compare at equal loudness
普通压缩：-24 至 +24 dB；Limiter：-120 至 +120 dB: Normal: -24 to +24 dB; Limiter: -120 to +120 dB. See pages 29-30 for headphone listening.
根据已播放素材做一次响度补偿，并写入 Makeup；不是持续自动音量。: Uses played material for a one-time loudness adjustment to Makeup. It is not continuous auto gain.
让有效响度读数建立，再点击 Match。选择能代表实际段落的声音，避免只播放极短: Allow a valid loudness reading to build before clicking Match. Use material that represents the passage, not just a very brief attack.
按当前监听方式比较: Compare in the current listening mode
普通模式比较 Dry 与补偿前 Wet；Limiter 耳机模式比较原始输入与实: Normal mode compares Dry with Wet before compensation. Limiter headphone mode compares original input with the actual limited listening output. Makeup changes Wet; see page 30.
必要时用 Makeup 或 Output Gain 小幅修正，再切换 Bypas: Use Makeup or Output Gain for any small correction. Compare with Bypass or A/B and listen to attacks, tails and consistency across the passage.
大压缩量与很低的电平: Deep compression and very low levels
补偿响度与限制峰值分开判断: Judge loudness and peak protection separately
Match 用来比较响度；Limiter 的 Ceiling 控制最终峰值。完成: Match helps compare loudness; Limiter's Ceiling controls final peaks. Check output and TP after matching, especially after upward processing or further parameter changes.
三个容易混淆的地方: Three distinctions to keep in mind
动态增益显示不包含 Makeup 与 Output Gain。Input / O: Dynamic gain excludes Makeup and Output Gain. Input / Output LINK only makes equal and opposite gain changes; it cannot replace loudness matching. At Mix = 0%, Input and Output Gain still apply, so this is not full Bypass.
A、B 为两组声音设置；A→B 与 B→A 用来复制。: A and B hold two sound settings. A→B and B→A copy between them.
在 A 调好算法与处理量。用 A→B 将它复制到 B，再切换到 B。复制会替换目: Set the algorithm and processing amount in A. Copy A→B, then switch to B. Copying replaces the destination sound settings.
只改变想比较的部分: Change the part you want to compare
例如 A 使用 Classic，B 使用 Super；或 A 使用向下压缩，B: For example, use Classic in A and Super in B, or compare downward and upward processing. Keep Lookahead, detector source and monitoring the same where possible.
对两组设置分别播放相同素材并 Match，必要时微调 Makeup。点 A /: Play the same material for each setting and use Match; trim Makeup if needed. Click A / B and compare the sound, without mistaking louder for better.
为什么倒数 Ratio 有时听起来一样？: Why can reciprocal Ratios sound the same?
上下曲线保留对称关系。在共同作用区内，一些倒数 Ratio 的结果只相差固定增益: The upward and downward curves retain a symmetrical relationship. In a shared active interval, some reciprocal settings differ only by a constant gain, so they can sound very close after loudness matching. One example is 8:1 versus 1:8 in Super / SINGLE with Threshold = -inf, Range = OFF and Mix = 100%.
Classic 在离开下限过渡的共同作用区内也有对应关系。跨越阈值、有限 Ran: Classic also has a corresponding relationship within a shared active interval, away from the lower gate transition. Crossing a threshold, entering a finite Range transition, changing Mix or changing the Dual handoff can break equality across a whole passage.
Lookahead：预读，但对齐正在处理的声音: Lookahead: align gain with the sound
Classic 与 Super 使用同一套电平检测时序。: Classic and Super share the same detector timing.
Lookahead 让插件在输出当前声音前，先看到后面一小段信号。这样可以用较稳: Lookahead lets the plugin see a short section of upcoming signal before it outputs the current sound. A more stable level estimate helps reduce harmonics caused by gain following every sine-wave cycle. Lookahead is not conventional Attack.
怎样减少大声到来前的凹陷: Reducing the dip before a louder event
检测同时参考当前声音之前与之后的窗口，并采用两边峰值中较低的一边。未来的大声不再: Detection considers windows before and after the current sound, then uses the lower of their two peaks. A future loud event no longer determines the attenuation of the preceding quiet passage on its own. When the loud event arrives, gain follows the aligned level estimate.
示意：两个窗口都包含当前时刻；实际输出仍按 Lookahead 延后。: Schematic: both windows include the present; output is still delayed by Lookahead.
保留低失真目标，也理解动态信号的取舍: Low distortion, with a trade-off on changing signals
稳定正弦可以在合适的窗口中得到稳定的增益，尽量保留波形形状。音乐不是恒定的正弦：: A suitable window can give steady sine waves stable gain and preserve their shape. Music is not a constant sine wave: rapid amplitude modulation, short events and complex combinations can still produce modulation residuals. Lookahead does not guarantee zero harmonic distortion for every signal.
新版优先减少不必要的提前衰减，让处理更贴近当前声音。若某段素材仍有细小凹陷或波形: This version prioritizes less unnecessary advance attenuation so processing follows the current sound more closely. If a passage still shows small dips or waveform changes, check the detector source, window length and actual audio. Do not judge the result from a Display trace alone.
Lookahead 影响电平估计与延迟，不是 Attack。窗口加长可能改善部分:
Lookahead affects level estimation and latency, not Attack. Longer windows may improve stability for some low-frequency or rapidly changing material, but do not improve every transient.
A longer window also increases plugin latency, which the host will usually compensate.
默认 26 ms；需要时与 40 ms 对照，按听感选择。: Default 26 ms. Compare with 40 ms if needed and choose by ear.
更长窗口；听是否更稳定，同时留意额外延迟。: Longer windows; listen for greater stability and consider the extra latency.
ST 与 LR：一起处理，或分别处理: ST and LR: together or independently
点击右下方 Mode 按钮，按 ST → MS → LR 循环切换。通常先用 S: Click Mode at the lower right to cycle ST → MS → LR. Start with ST; choose LR when the two sides genuinely need different treatment.
LR：上方为 L，下方为 R，各有独立控件。: LR: L above, R below, with independent controls.
对立体声使用共同压缩增益，适合作为人声、乐器和总线的起点。: Uses common compression gain for stereo; a useful starting point for tracks and buses.
左右各有独立的 Ratio、边界、Makeup 和 Mix；DUAL 时每侧各有: Left and right have independent Ratio, boundary, Makeup and Mix controls. In DUAL, each side has its own UP / DOWN. Check for image shifts when processing asymmetric material.
选择 L 或 R 可单独监听对应一侧，并居中呈现，便于比较。结束后回到 ALL，: Choose L or R to audition that side centred. Return to ALL to check normal stereo, and do not leave one-sided audition active for the final output.
MS / DUAL：上方为 Mid，下方为 Side；每个声道各有 UP / D: MS / DUAL: Mid is above Side. Each channel has its own UP / DOWN Ratios and thresholds.
Mid 主要反映左右共有的内容，Side 反映左右差异。它们并不精确对应“中间一: Mid mainly represents content common to both sides; Side represents their differences. They are not a precise separation of a centre track from every other track.
先听 M 与 S 各包含什么: Listen to M and S first
用 MONITOR 的 M / S 检查素材，再回到 ALL。: Use M / S under MONITOR, then return to ALL.
例如需要收住中心动态时，先调 M 的 Ratio / Mix；需要保留环境与宽度: For steadier centre dynamics, start with M Ratio / Mix. Treat S cautiously when preserving ambience and width.
M/S 的压缩或音量变化可能改变空间感。回到 ALL 后检查中心、宽度和单声道兼: Compression or level changes in M/S can alter the sense of space. In ALL, check centre, width and mono compatibility, not only soloed domains.
声道 LINK：保留差异，一起调整: Channel LINK: adjust together, keep differences
在 LR 或 MS 模式下，Mode 旁的 LINK 用于声道之间的同类参数。先: In LR or MS, LINK beside Mode links matching parameters across channels. Set the two sides separately, then enable it to adjust them together without forcing identical values.
SINGLE 示例：Mode 旁的声道 LINK 已开启，左右 Ratio 仍分: SINGLE example: channel LINK beside Mode is on, while the left and right Ratios remain at 3:1 and 5:1.
关闭 LINK，建立两侧关系: Set the relationship with LINK off
先确定哪一侧需要更强的压缩或更少的混合。: Decide which domain needs more compression or a different blend.
拖动任意一侧同类参数，另一侧跟随同样的变化量。精调和直接输入也适用。: Move either parameter in a pair; the other follows by the same change. Fine adjustment and direct entry work too.
任意一侧将超出范围时，两侧会停在能保留差值的位置。Super 中一侧 Thres: If either side would exceed its range, both stop where the difference can be retained. In Super, one Threshold at -inf cannot form a finite dB offset; set both thresholds to finite values first if you want that relationship.
Ratio 中间的小 LINK 管每个声道内的 Up / Down 反向联动；M: The small LINK between the Ratios links Up / Down within each channel. LINK beside Mode links matching L/R or M/S parameters. With both enabled, channels move together while each channel retains its existing Up / Down relationship. LINK beside Input only controls opposite input/output gain changes; see page 12.
点击右上角 SC: INT / SC: EXT 打开，按钮文字表示当前来源。: Click SC: INT / SC: EXT at the top right. Its label shows the current source.
INT 根据当前轨道本身判断；EXT 根据另一条轨道送来的信号控制当前轨道的提升: INT follows the current track itself. EXT uses a signal sent from another track to control boost or attenuation on the current track.
只在 EXT 可用。调整外部 Key 的检测电平，改变触发强度，不直接调主轨道音: Available only with EXT. Adjusts the external detector level and trigger strength, not the main track level.
减少检测信号中的低频；作用于 INT 或 EXT。OFF 为全频，开启后范围 2: Reduces low frequencies in the INT or EXT detector key. OFF is full-band; active range is 20-500 Hz.
查看送到检测器的信号是否有电平。EXT 显示 N/A 时，先检查宿主侧链通道是否: Check that the detector receives a signal. With EXT showing N/A, first check that the host sidechain bus is enabled.
临时听检测信号，帮助检查路由与 HPF；听完关闭，再判断正常输出。: Temporarily audition the detector key to check routing and HPF. Switch it off before judging normal output.
低频一来整段都被压：用 INT + HPF，见第 22 页。<br/>希望鼓声出:
Low notes pull the whole part down: try INT + HPF, page 22.
Want bass to duck when the kick plays? Use EXT, page 23.
适用场景：处理鼓组、Mix Bus 或母带时，底鼓或贝斯每次出现都会把其他内容明: Use this when kick or bass repeatedly pulls down the rest of a drum bus, mix bus or master. The goal is less low-frequency triggering, not less bass in the audible signal.
先用 INT 听清问题: Start with INT and hear the problem
循环一段低频与其他内容同时出现的素材，保持 HPF 为 OFF，建立对比。: Loop a passage with bass and other content together. Leave HPF OFF to establish a comparison.
点击 SC: INT，确认 SOURCE 仍选 INT。Key Gain 此时灰: Click SC: INT and keep SOURCE on INT. A disabled Key Gain is normal here.
从较低截止频率开始，听低频到来时整段是否还被过度压低。一次只改一点。: Start at a low cutoff and listen for less whole-mix ducking on bass events. Make small changes.
打开 SC LISTEN，听 HPF 去掉了哪些低频；随后关闭，回到完整声音。: Use SC LISTEN to hear which bass content HPF removes, then turn it off and return to the full sound.
HPF 的历史图在松手后刷新；如果显示 HPF UPDATING，等它消失再比较: HPF history refreshes after you release the knob. If HPF UPDATING appears, wait for it to clear before comparing.
滤波后 GR 可能变少或形状变化。根据目的用 Ratio、Threshold 或: Filtering may reduce GR or change its shape. Revisit Ratio, Threshold or Mix as needed, then compare at similar loudness.
听起来“没有切低频”是正常的: It is normal not to hear bass being cut
HPF 只过滤用于判断压缩的 Key，不直接滤波正常输出。它也不是 Key Ga: HPF filters only the key used to decide compression, not normal output. It is not equivalent to Key Gain: Key Gain scales the detector level; HPF changes frequency weighting. Too high a cutoff can make the compressor ignore bass that still needs control.
插件插在“要被压低”的贝斯轨道上；底鼓只作为触发来源送入它的侧链。不要把插件插反: Insert the plug-in on the bass - the track to turn down. Send the kick to its sidechain as the trigger. Do not reverse the tracks or confuse a normal audio send with a sidechain send.
启用贝斯轨上这个插件实例的侧链输入；在底鼓轨道添加指向它的侧链发送，并打开发送。: Enable sidechain input for this plug-in instance on the bass. Add and enable a kick send to that sidechain. Names and locations vary by host.
点击 SC 按钮，把 SOURCE 切到 EXT。播放底鼓并检查 KEY LEV: Open SC, choose EXT and play the kick. Check KEY LEVEL first; if it has no reading, fix routing before increasing Ratio.
短暂打开 SC LISTEN，应听到底鼓而不是贝斯。确认后关闭试听。: Briefly enable SC LISTEN: you should hear the kick, not the bass. Turn audition off afterward.
为向下避让，可先用 SINGLE、Ratio 高于 1:1、Range OFF；: For downward ducking, start with SINGLE, Ratio above 1:1 and Range OFF. Set detector strength with Key Gain or the send level, and set the lower boundary with Threshold. Leave HPF OFF initially.
用 Mix 决定让出多少空间: Use Mix to decide how much room to make
先找到清楚的避让，再减小 Mix，保留需要的贝斯持续感。边听两条轨道边调，不只听: Find an audible duck, then reduce Mix to retain the desired bass sustain. Listen to both tracks together, not only solo bass.
提高 HPF 会减少底鼓低频的触发，可能反而减弱你想要的避让。只在需要更偏向敲击: Raising HPF reduces low-frequency kick triggering and may weaken the duck you want. Use it when you want more emphasis on the attack or less unwanted low-bass triggering.
没有传统 Attack / Release 可调；避让形状会受触发素材、Look: There are no conventional Attack / Release controls. Ducking shape depends on the trigger, Lookahead and compression settings; it is not guaranteed to be smoother than every conventional sidechain.
把操作放回真实混音: Apply it in a real mix
人声、吉他、钢琴：稳住动态，保留表达: Vocals, guitar, piano: consistency with articulation
先试 SINGLE / ST / INT 和 26 ms，把 Ratio 调到: Try SINGLE / ST / INT and 26 ms. Raise Ratio above 1:1, then use Mix to keep consonants, plucks or hammer attacks natural. To process only louder parts, raise Threshold and leave Range OFF. Use Match and compare in the mix.
尾音与轻声：让选中的细节靠前: Tails and quiet phrases: bring detail forward
想抬起较轻的字、拨弦尾音或残响时，试单压向上；用 Threshold 排除不想提: Try Single upward processing to lift quieter words, pluck tails or reverb. Use Threshold to exclude unwanted very quiet sounds and Range to set the upper limit. To also control louder parts, switch to Dual and adjust Up and Down separately. Use the branch ON / OFF switches to audition each direction. Turn Ratio LINK off if you also want to adjust each Ratio independently.
Mix Bus / 母带：追求整体凝聚感: Mix bus / mastering: a more cohesive balance
当你想要整体更稳、更有 Glue，又不希望传统 Attack / Release: When you want a steadier, more cohesive mix without deliberately reshaping drum attacks through conventional Attack / Release, try it as an alternative to G Bus-style compression. Start gently, compare balance across sections and lower Mix when needed.
底鼓一来就压低全曲时，试 INT + HPF；不要为了让 GR 更小而把 HPF: If every kick pulls the whole mix down, try INT + HPF. Do not raise the cutoff merely to make the GR number smaller. At similar loudness, check drum attack, low end, space and the song’s larger dynamic movement.
人声触发伴奏：清出唱词空间: Vocal-keyed accompaniment: make space for words
把插件插在伴奏总线上，将人声送到它的外部侧链，选 EXT。先用 SC LISTE: Insert the plugin on the backing bus, send the vocal to its external sidechain and choose EXT. Confirm the source with SC LISTEN. Select SINGLE, Ratio above 1:1 and Range OFF, then adjust Key Gain, Threshold and Mix so the backing steps back while the vocal plays.
如果爆破音触发过重，试着提高侧链 HPF。如果呼吸或底噪也让伴奏退让，先检查发送: If plosives trigger too much ducking, try raising sidechain HPF. If breaths or noise also make the accompaniment dip, check the sent signal and Threshold; HPF alone will not solve every unwanted trigger.
关闭 SC LISTEN；声道 MONITOR 回到 ALL；确认前后响度接近。: Turn off SC LISTEN, return channel MONITOR to ALL, and bring the before/after loudness close. For final peak control, enable Limiter and set Ceiling. Combine the headphone button with Match for level-matched listening; see pages 25-31.
Ceiling 与 TP：选择最终上限: Ceiling and TP: choose the final limit
TP 读数：看实际输出，保留峰值: TP meter: measure output and hold peaks
右侧 TP L/R 读数，监测最终左右立体声的真峰值。: The TP L/R readout measures true peaks in the final left/right stereo output.
TP 表读取实际输出，包含 Makeup、Mix、Output Gain、Cei: The TP meter reads actual output, including Makeup, Mix, Output Gain, Ceiling and headphone 1:1 compensation. It does not simply display the Ceiling setting, or clamp its reading to that setting.
峰值读数会保留约 20 秒；出现新的更高峰值时更新并重新计时。Hold 按音频播: The peak reading holds for about 20 seconds. A new higher peak updates the value and restarts the timer. Hold advances with audio playback time.
鼠标双击 TP 读数即可立即归零，再播放检查片段。无需等待旧峰值自动消退。: Double-click the TP readout to clear it immediately, then play the passage again. There is no need to wait for the previous held peak to expire.
保留的旧峰值可能来自修改前的设置。先清零，再判断当前上限是否符合预期。: A held peak may come from earlier settings. Clear it before deciding whether the current limit behaves as expected.
关闭 TP 后读数高于 Ceiling: TP exceeds Ceiling with TP off
TP 表仍测量真峰值；采样峰值保护不保证采样间峰值同样受限。: The meter still measures true peaks. Sample-peak protection does not also guarantee the intersample peak limit.
监听补偿已计入读数，请结合 MON 换算上限判断。: The readout includes listening compensation. Judge it against the converted MON limit.
MS 的单域表与 TP 不同: MS domain meters differ from TP
TP 看最终 L/R；单独的 M/S 电平与左右输出上限不是同一个量。: TP measures final L/R. Individual M/S levels and left/right output limits are different quantities.
Output Gain 左侧的小耳机，只在 Limiter 模式显示。: The small headphone button left of Output Gain appears only in Limiter.
耳机点亮后，Output 的数值和联动保留；下方出现 MON 监听上限。: With headphones on, Output values and links stay active. MON shows the listening limit below.
打开耳机，声音仍完整经过动态处理和 Ceiling，然后再抵消可见 Output: With headphones on, audio still passes through the complete dynamics and Ceiling stages. The visible Output Gain is then cancelled. Limiting's dynamic and waveform changes remain; only the listening level is adjusted for comparison.
Ceiling 也换到同一监听标准: Ceiling follows the same listening reference
例如 Ceiling = -1 dB、Output = +6 dB，耳机开启时对: For example, Ceiling = -1 dB and Output = +6 dB give a listening limit of -7 dB with headphones on. The Ceiling setting stays at -1 dB. Switching headphones off restores the normal output reference. TP measures the actual output.
耳机开关默认关闭，随工程保存，独立于 A/B。切换 A/B 时可以一直保持同一监: Headphones default to off, are saved with the project, and remain independent of A/B. Keep the same listening mode while comparing A/B. Headphone and Bypass switches use smooth transitions; headphones add no separate audio delay.
1:1 不会自动等响: 1:1 does not automatically mean equal loudness
耳机只抵消 Output Gain，并不自动弥补压缩、Ceiling 或 Inp: Headphones cancel Output Gain; they do not automatically compensate all loudness changes from compression, Ceiling or Input. Use Match for a level-matched comparison. The next page gives the full procedure.
让响度读数建立。修改参数后会重新收集数据；持续调参、完全静音或刚开始播放时，不要: Allow loudness measurements to build. Parameter changes start fresh measurement collection. Do not rush to Match while adjusting continuously, during silence or immediately after starting playback.
耳机模式比较原始输入与真正经过 Ceiling、耳机补偿后的输出。LR / MS: Headphone mode compares original input with actual output after Ceiling and headphone compensation. LR / MS use a common correction, preserving relative channel balance. The dry/wet blend is included.
用插件 Bypass 比较原声: Compare the original with plugin Bypass
Bypass 返回延迟对齐的原始输入，不经过限幅或耳机音量补偿。听起音、尾音、密: Bypass returns delay-aligned original input without limiting or headphone gain compensation. Listen for attack, tails, density and groove; trim Makeup if needed.
结束试听，恢复正常输出: Finish listening and restore normal output
关闭耳机，保留调好的参数。重新检查 TP 和 Ceiling，再判断送往后级的最: Switch headphones off and keep the adjusted settings. Check TP and Ceiling again before judging the final signal sent downstream.
Match 做一次补偿，不持续追着音量跑: Match applies one correction, not continuous gain riding
素材段落改变、Ceiling 深度改变或继续调参后，可以重新播放并 Match。: After changing the passage, limiting depth or other parameters, play again and Match. With Limiter LINK off, controls at their limits, or Mix fully dry, the compensation available through Makeup may be restricted.
确认顶部 LIMITER 已开启；这些控件只在该模式显示。: Enable LIMITER at the top; these controls appear only in that mode.
这是监听补偿的用途。数值及联动仍有效，关闭耳机恢复正常输出。: That is the listening compensation. Values and links remain active; switch headphones off for normal output.
先确认听的是哪一路: Confirm which signal you are hearing
OFF 或有限上界: OFF or a set upper boundary
参数速查：音量、监听与侧链: Quick reference: gain, monitoring and SC
ALL / L / R 或 M / S: ALL / L / R or M / S
确认对应 Ratio 低于 1:1，Mix 大于 0，Bypass 关闭；Dua: Check that the relevant Ratio is below 1:1, Mix is above 0% and Bypass is off. In Dual, that branch must be ON.
检测电平要高于 UP、低于 DOWN。UP 以下原样输出，高于 DOWN 时只做: The detector must be above UP and below DOWN. Below UP, the original level is retained; above DOWN, only downward processing applies.
两根边界是否重合？重合会使整个动态处理停止；分开后再比较。: Do the boundaries coincide? This stops all dynamic processing. Separate them before comparing.
较响的部分突然不再处理: Loud parts suddenly stop being processed
SINGLE 是否设置了有限 Range？达到或超过它时动态增益回到 0 dB；: Is a finite Range set in SINGLE? At or above it, dynamic gain returns to 0 dB. Select OFF if you want no upper cutoff.
两个 Ratio 中间的 LINK 默认开启。需要独立调整时，先关闭它。: LINK between the two Ratios is on by default. Turn it off to adjust them independently.
另一侧可能已到范围边界；联动会共同停止。反向调整即可继续。: The other Ratio may have reached its limit, stopping both controls. Reverse the adjustment to continue.
看着主轨道电平却不按预期触发: Main track level does not explain triggering
检查 SOURCE 是否为 EXT，或 HPF 是否改变了检测信号。阈值判断依据: Check whether SOURCE is EXT or HPF is changing the detector signal. Threshold decisions follow the detector signal.
选择 DUAL，关闭 DOWN 旁的开关，并关闭 Ratio LINK。保持 M: Select DUAL, switch DOWN off and turn Ratio LINK off. Keep Mix at 100% and all gain controls at 0 dB. Choose a suitable Lookahead.
确保素材在两个阈值之间: Place the signal between the thresholds
例如 UP 为 -50 dB、DOWN 为 -20 dB，确认一段轻声的检测电平: For example, set UP to -50 dB and DOWN to -20 dB. Check that the detector level of a quiet passage lies mainly between them. With Ratio still at 1:1, there is no boost yet.
将 Up Ratio 依次调向 1:2、1:4、1:8，同时听音，观察 Boos: Move Up Ratio through 1:2, 1:4 and 1:8 while listening and watching Boost / Mix and positive dynamic gain. Once confirmed, enable DOWN to add attenuation and compare overall loudness again.
Classic 压缩后，为什么有时低于阈值？: Why can Classic output fall below the threshold?
阈值约束的是检测电平上的增益曲线，不是最终输出的最低线。一个窗口内比检测峰值更轻: Threshold defines the gain curve for the detector level, not a minimum output level. Quieter sounds within a window can receive the gain set by its peak. Shared ST gain, external sidechain or HPF can also make the detector differ from the signal you see. Makeup and Output Gain then change the output further.
Range OFF、内部检测、各音量为 0 dB、Mix 100% 时，稳定且高: With Range OFF, internal detection, all gains at 0 dB and Mix at 100%, a steady level above threshold stays at or above it under the Classic formula. If a dip appears only in the Display, remember that it is a historical projection and check the actual audio. Not every dip is advance compression.
确认宿主侧链输入和发送已启用，SOURCE 为 EXT，KEY LEVEL 有读: Enable the host sidechain input and send. Select EXT and check KEY LEVEL. N/A means no external bus is available.
当前为 INT 时正常；它只调整外部 Key。: Normal with INT: it adjusts only the external key.
HPF 不切输出低频: HPF does not cut output bass
它只过滤检测信号。历史在松手后刷新，等 HPF UPDATING 消失再看。: It filters the detector only. History refreshes after release; wait for HPF UPDATING to clear.
关闭 SC LISTEN；MONITOR 回到 ALL，再检查 LR / MS。: Turn off SC LISTEN, return MONITOR to ALL, then check LR / MS.
播放足够的非静音素材，建立有效读数；低于旧门限不再自动禁用。: Play enough non-silent material for valid readings. Falling below the old gate no longer disables matching.
插件延迟改变，宿主可能重新调整补偿；录音监听也要考虑延迟。: Latency changes, so the host may readjust compensation. Also consider latency when monitoring a live recording.
这是 Display 绘制范围，不表示声音被截断。: This is the Display range, not an audio cutoff.
